welcome_lead: Trust your model: verify the code and validate against reality.

final_note: Verification: build it right. Validation: build the right thing.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Verification: bug-free implementation of equations.

Validation: comparison to historical data and experiments.

dS/dt = -βSI, dI/dt = βSI - γI, dR/dt = γI.

R_0 = β/γ predicts outbreak severity.

Doubling CO2 raises temperature by ~3 °C (range 2-4).

Validated against past climates and observations.
